decision.summary: A multi-axis transient offset begins near index 486, with clear onset and sustained interior (486–505) across N/E/U. N shows a sharp rebound by ~506, but E and U do not return to pre-offset levels before the allowed context ends at 545; thus the return phase is incomplete and ambiguous. No confirmed temporary interval due to missing opposing return on E/U; status is uncertain.

intervals.observation: N/E/U show correlated multi-sample drop (~3–4 MAD) starting near index 486, with sustained offset through ~505; N rebounds sharply after 505, while E and U remain depressed and recover only shallowly within allowed context (up to 545), so opposing return is unobserved/ambiguous.
